The Pavilion of Doctors Stelae at the Temple of Literature in Hanoi is a remarkable testament to Vietnam's rich educational and cultural heritage. This site houses 82 stone steles, each meticulously carved to commemorate the names of successful candidates from the imperial examinations held during the Later Le Dynasty and the Mac Dynasty between 1442 and 1779.
